name: all-outdoor-adventures
install:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm install 20
nvm alias default 20
nvm use 20
npm ci

terminals.name: vite-dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 20 >/dev/null; npm run dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the React SPA. Serves the site with hot reload on http://localhost:5173 (also exposed on the container network via --host). Node is loaded via nvm because the platform's default node lacks npm.
